decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out and retained in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Reasonable Exemption
Statement, 070_PL_05, 070_PL_06, Site Location Plan, Noise Impact Assessment (REPORT
No: 33B150425HA74DJ; Dated: 25/04/2025), Design and Access Statement

<ol><li style="padding:3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt"><span aptos="">The building services plant shall be installed , operated, and maintained in accordance with the approved Ron-Berks Acoustic Ltd, Environmental Noise Impact Assessment, 33 The Broadway, Stanmore, HA7 4DJ, REPORT No: 33B150425HA74DJ; Date: 25/04/2025, and the following shall apply to safeguard the occupiers of the property above the commercial premises and to any nearby occupied neighbouring premises. </span></li></ol><p style="margin-left:36.0pt; padding:3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt">If any noise-sensitive receptors are identified that are closer than those assessed in the submitted Noise Impact Assessment, the applicant shall submit an updated noise and vibration impact assessment in accordance with BS4142:2014+A1:2019 for approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Any necessary mitigation measures required shall be installed within 1 month of approval of the updated Noise Report by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p style="margin-left:36.0pt; padding:3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt"><span aptos="">The cumulative rating level of noise from all building services plant shall be at least 10 dB (A) below the representative background sound level ( LA90) at the façade of the nearest noise-sensitive premises, with appropriate corrections applied for tonal, impulsive, or intermittent characteristics, in line with BS4142:2014. </span></p><p style="margin-left:36.0pt; padding:3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt"><span aptos="">The operation of any plant or equipment shall not result in preceptive vibration within the development or adjoining residential or nearby noise-sensitive premises.</span></p><p style="margin-left:36.0pt; padding:3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt"><span aptos="">No plant shall operate outside the hours of 08:00 to 22:00, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</span></p><p style="margin-left:36.0pt; padding:3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt"><span aptos="">All plant shall be installed, operated, and maintained in accordance with the approved details, and any required mitigation shall be implemented prior to operation and retained for the lifetime of the development.</span></p><p style="margin-left:36.0pt; padding:3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt"><span aptos="">REASON: To ensure that the proposed Plant Units does not result in unacceptable noise and vibration impacts to the existing and future occupiers of the premises and to the neighbouring premises in accordance with Policy D14 of The London Plan (2021), Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Local Policies Plan (2013), and the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).</span></p><p style="text-align: left;"><br></p><p style="text-align: left;"><br></p><p style="text-align: left;"><br></p><p style="text-align: left;"><br></p><p style="text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>
description: Installation of two rear external condenser units and retention and consolidation of existing refrigeration infrastructure (retrospective)
